posts.zh:
dsh-mojibake-interceptor 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 乱码拦截器 bundle：写入前特征值/编码回环检测乱码并复查放行（原样重试即通过），pwsh 写入编码执行前审计（ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/默认编码），Windows 与中文场景优先。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c7ea589a2b474e981dd7.html
posts.en:
dsh-mojibake-interceptor is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Mojibake guard bundle for DSH: feature-based garbled-text detection before writes with review-then-release (an identical retry passes), plus pre-execution pwsh encoding audit (ANSI/GBK/UTF-16/Default), Windows and Chinese first.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-c7ea589a2b474e981dd7.html
